name: Habits
description: Small daily habits, ticked off in a tap. Streaks and reminders stay on this phone.
schema: CREATE TABLE habits (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(8)))), name TEXT NOT NULL, emoji TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '✨', created TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')))
CREATE TABLE checks (habit TEXT NOT NULL, day TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (habit, day))

INSERT INTO habits (id, name, emoji, created) VALUES ('water', 'Drink 2 l of water', '💧', datetime('now', '-4 seconds')), ('walk', 'Walk 20 minutes', '🚶', datetime('now', '-3 seconds')), ('read', 'Read 10 pages', '📚', datetime('now', '-2 seconds')), ('screens', 'No screens after 22:00', '🌙', datetime('now', '-1 seconds'))

INSERT INTO checks (habit, day) WITH RECURSIVE d(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM d WHERE n < 13) SELECT h.id, date('now', 'localtime', '-' || d.n || ' days') FROM habits h, d WHERE (h.id = 'water') OR (h.id = 'walk' AND d.n % 3 <> 0) OR (h.id = 'read' AND d.n < 6) OR (h.id = 'screens' AND d.n % 2 = 0)
ALTER TABLE habits ADD COLUMN art TEXT
UPDATE habits SET art = '/img/' || CASE id WHEN 'screens' THEN 'moon' ELSE id END || '.svg' WHERE id IN ('water', 'walk', 'read', 'screens')

card.query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM checks WHERE day = date('now', 'localtime')) AS done, (SELECT count(*) FROM habits) AS total, (SELECT count(*) FROM checks WHERE day > date('now', 'localtime', '-7 days')) AS week
card.chart: WITH RECURSIVE d(n) AS (SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT n - 1 FROM d WHERE n > 0) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM checks WHERE day = date('now', 'localtime', '-' || d.n || ' days')) AS checks FROM d

widget.query: SELECT done, total, round(1.0 * done / max(total, 1), 2) AS ratio, week FROM (SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM checks WHERE day = date('now', 'localtime')) AS done, (SELECT count(*) FROM habits) AS total, (SELECT count(*) FROM checks WHERE day > date('now', 'localtime', '-7 days')) AS week)

children.query: WITH RECURSIVE d(n) AS (SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT n - 1 FROM d WHERE n > 0) SELECT strftime('%d', 'now', 'localtime', '-' || n || ' days') AS label, (SELECT count(*) FROM checks WHERE day = date('now', 'localtime', '-' || d.n || ' days')) AS value FROM d
